notes.subject: gɛlɛya
notes.rationale: צרה kɔrɔ tiɲɛna ye 'kɛnɛ dɔgɔya' ye (dɔgɔyali), a bɛ fɔ gɛlɛya la Bamanankan na

notes.subject: nin gɛlɛya in na
notes.rationale: Bamanankan mago bɛ a la kɔrɔfɔli kɛ ka a jira bɔyɔrɔ ye, Heburukan t'o la

notes.subject: i k'a wele ne na
notes.rationale: Yawe ka weleli sinsin ko a wele a la gɛlɛya donw la; tapuli ka tugu 50:14 weleli la

notes.subject: i
notes.rationale: Yawe bɛ kuma kɔrɔdɔgɔ weleli ɲɛ 'i' ye

translation: I k'a wele ne na don min na gɛlɛya bɛ; ne bɛna i bɔ ⟨nin gɛlɛya in na⟩, i tuguni na ne nimuya.
